messages:
ci-alert-bot: :warning: nightly-eval alert (5234567890) — samplehole cohort spike. 3 prompt cohorts failing: samplehole-legal, samplehole-financial, samplehole-qa. Affected variants: redwood-v2-qlo, redwood-v2-int4. Initial severity: P2. Alert details: https://internal/alerts/5234567890

alex: looking — do we have quick diffs? did this coincide with any deploys yesterday? :eyes:

maria: deploys yes — quant profile push to int4/ql0 rolled at 2026-03-17T22:10Z. Failures are mostly blank or hallucinated citations (short outputs where we expected structured answers).

devon: assigning to me + kevin. I'll grab the eval logs. Quick repro command: `./bin/eval_runner --suite samplehole_* --model redwood-v2-qlo --since 2026-03-17`

kevin: ran a smoke locally — I see KV cache misses for long-context prompts after quant. Snapshot: 
```
# truncated log
2026-03-18T03:12:02Z model=redwood-v2-qlo seq=1024 kvcache_miss=TRUE out=""
2026-03-18T03:12:03Z model=redwood-v2-qlo seq=1024 gen_len=12 out="(empty)"
```
Looks like prefix tokens not being restored for quantized kernels.

alex: interesting — is this only in qlo/int4 or also float32?

maria: float32 runs are clean (ran `--model redwood-v2-fp32`), so likely quant path regression.

devon: plan: (1) reproduce deterministically on staging (2) enable kvcache debug logs and per-layer checksum (3) if confirmed revert quant profile for qlo. owner=devon, ops=kevin. ETA 2h.

kevin: I can add a small instrumentation patch: toggle env `KVCACHE_DEBUG=1` and run `python -m tools.kvcache_check --model redwood-v2-qlo --prompt tests/samplehole_llm.json`. If mismatch, dump `kv_state.bin` for analysis.

maria: severity stays P2 unless we see customer-facing delta. This is internal eval but we should prioritize because onboarding relies on these cohorts. I nominate devon as primary and maria as alert owner for escalation.

devon: running full-suite now. dropping a quick reproducer: `python eval_local.py --cohort samplehole-legal --model redwood-v2-qlo --seed 1337 --max-tokens 512`

(30m later) devon: initial reproduce succeeded on staging. behavior: blank outputs when prefix length > 800 tokens, appears at kv merge stage. attaching local trace: `trace_kv_merge.log`

kevin: confirmed trace shows mismatched ordering in quant kernel 3. suspect our int8 packing change. I'll bisect the kernel commit and run the microbench.

alex: good catch. If bisect identifies regression, coordinate rollback. Are any downstream dashboards or canaries impacted?

maria: no live traffic impact reported. still internal. ops: runbook suggests rollback of quant profile if bisect <= 1hr. Link: https://internal/runbooks/quant-kernel-regressions

devon: created a short patch to dump kvcache checksums at layer boundaries. pushing to staging now. will confirm before running rollback.

kevin: started bisect: commits 87f..a9b. If we hit a bad commit, I'll open a revert PR and tag @maria for approval.

maria: assignment summary: owner=devon, ops=kevin, alert_owner=maria. severity=P2. ETA checkpoint 2h, full resolution 6h if revert needed. Close criteria: all three cohorts pass nightly eval or quant profile reverted and CI green.

alex: TY. please paste final status here when resolved.

(1h 40m later) devon: root cause identified — kernel packing change in commit a3b4c7 caused misaligned KV offsets for long prefixes. Revert PR opened: https://internal/pulls/3344. Running staged eval after revert.

kevin: revert merged, staging eval run shows cohorts pass. `samplehole-legal` output now matches baseline.

ci-alert-bot: Update: alert 5234567890 -> resolved (status: mitigated).

maria: marking resolved. postmortem follow-up: add long-prefix unit tests for quant kernels and add kvcache checksum assertion to nightly smoke. I'll create a tracking ticket. :memo:

alex: closing on our side. great teamwork. :tada:
